key.name: language
key.description: Language code used by the application. Use "auto" to follow the system locale, or a gettext language code such as "en", "es", "fr", "it", "pl", "pt_BR", "zh_CN" or "zh_HK".

key.name: default-compress-format
key.description: Archive format used when compressing. Supported: 7z, tar, zip.

key.name: default-compress-level
key.description: Compression level used by default compression.

key.name: default-compress-method
key.description: Compression algorithm used by default compression.

key.name: default-compress-dictionary-size
key.description: Dictionary size in MB used by default compression. Use 0 for the 7-Zip default.

key.name: default-compress-threads
key.description: Thread count used by default compression. Use 0 for the 7-Zip default.

key.name: default-compress-encrypt-names
key.description: Whether to encrypt file names when creating password-protected 7z archives.

key.name: compress-scan-depth
key.description: Maximum number of folder levels to scan when recommending compression parameters.

key.name: default-timeout
key.description: Default timeout in seconds for archive operations. Use -1 for no timeout.

key.name: extract-subfolder-behavior
key.description: Controls whether to create a subfolder when extracting: "always" to always create, "never" to never create, "smart" to create only when archive has multiple top-level entries.
